_published_faq.name: How do I add Little Bookshop to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Little Bookshop to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://fast-pulse-yejn9.run.mcp-use.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Little Bookshop MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 13, 2026, Little Bookshop scores 75/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Little Bookshop's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 13, 2026, Little Bookshop scores 51/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 7 of 7 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Little Bookshop in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
